baseline_definitions.definition: Always predict class 0; compute heldout performance only after explicit separate inference authorization.

calibration.scope: Training-only learnability control must be independently specified and reviewed; no heldout labels or checkpoints may select architecture, seed, threshold, hyperparameters, or baseline.

quality_interpretation.failure_or_missing_run_policy: Report all proposed seeds and failed runs without posthoc exclusion; suspend quality-matched cost claims if any required paired seed is invalid.
